label: Population (July 1 estimate)
notes: 2000-2019 use the Census Bureau's revised (intercensal) estimates, so there is no artificial jump at 2010 or 2020.

label: Population per square mile of land
notes: population / land_area_sqmi. Uses current land area for every year.

label: Births during the year ending July 1
notes: Year ending July 1. Missing for 2000, 2010, 2020: in census years the estimates cover only April-July.

label: Deaths during the year ending July 1
Domestic migration rate
notes: domestic_migration / population x 1000. Negative = more people moved out.

label: Median age
notes: Medians cannot be added up across counties.

label: Percent American Indian / Alaska Native alone, not Hispanic
Percent Native Hawaiian / Pacific Islander alone, not Hispanic
Percent two or more races, not Hispanic
notes: The seven race/ethnicity percentages are mutually exclusive and sum to 100.

label: People in poverty (all ages)
notes: Statistical model estimate. Before 2000, county estimates exist only for 1989, 1993, 1995, 1997.

label: Unemployment rate
notes: unemployed / labor_force x 100 (published by BLS for counties). Connecticut is reported as the 9 planning regions in every year. 2025 (full build only) is an 11-month average because October 2025 data was not collected.

label: Total personal income
notes: Missing for small Virginia independent cities, which BEA combines with a neighboring county.

label: Adults age 25 and over (education universe)
notes: Census for 1970-2000 (via USDA ERS). From 2009 on, 5-year survey averages labeled by their last year (2024 = 2020-2024).

label: Percent of adults 25+ without a high school diploma
Percent of adults 25+ with high school diploma only
Percent of adults 25+ with some college or associate degree
Percent of adults 25+ with a bachelor's degree or higher
notes: 1970/1980: four or more years of college.

label: Median value of owner-occupied homes
notes: 5-year survey average labeled by its last year.

label: Median gross rent (rent + utilities)
notes: 5-year survey average labeled by its last year.

label: Percent of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied
Percent of population born outside the US
Gini index of household income inequality
Total votes cast for president
notes: Presidential election years only. No Alaska data (it reports by legislative district, not county). Kansas City, MO votes are included in Jackson County.
